quote: Add DRAFT label list to the `session-log-check.py` reminder text
why: This decision directly implements the DRAFT format baseline by embedding DRAFT labels in session-log hooks so agents see the format when writing entries.
None of the candidates establish or enforce the four edge kinds (replaces, evolves, related_entries, evolved_by) or their acyclic/forward-only properties; all are tangential graph-topology work.

All candidates share only the control-plane topic but concern configuration persistence, MCP routing, or release process - none address encoding policy (UTF-8, LF, NFC normalization) ownership or duplication prevention.
This decision directly addresses entry ID generation and linking, which is the core concern of the entry_id_scheme ADR regarding deterministic ID allocation.
Candidates address format coupling tests, hygiene audits, and CI pipeline work but none concern experiment fixture isolation via nearest-runtime discovery or standalone fixture repositories.
